context:
Goal: the consultant merges the carry-list pull requests itself, so they stop waiting on a hand-off to runner 10.
Problem (rule): the merge tool refuses a standing session any pull request it did not open, and no code reads a session's goal, so "the PRs the goal names" has no source the tool can check; only you can say which route to allow.
Based on (ruling): your 10:15 CST Nov 18 chat words, relayed by the consultant: "this always was a yes??"; ruling own-tiny-fixes-b (00:50 CST Nov 15, in decision session-tiers) lets a standing session merge its own pull requests.
Based on (read): the consultant's test-author search found no goal reader on origin/main; merge/merge.py standing_refusal (about line 6707) is the refusal.
Departs from: main — the merge tool refuses a standing session any pull request it did not open — and this adds a route to merge another session's pull request.
Waiting on: nothing stopped; the consultant keeps routing carry-list pull requests to runner 10 until you pick.

options.gain: No goal reader to build, and the carry is visible in the pull request.
options.how: The tool accepts that line like the session's own link; every other merge check stays unchanged.
options.label: A "Carried by" line in the pull request body that the carrying session adds (recommended by the consultant)
options.lose: Any session could add the line to any pull request, so the line is not a real limit; a reviewer and the other checks still stand.

options.gain: Tied to your own goal text, so only what you named can be carried.
options.how: The tool reads the owner's goal and accepts only pull requests it names.
options.label: A builder first adds a reader of the goal text the harness stores, then the tool accepts pull requests that goal names
options.lose: A new reader of harness state, and it takes longer to build.

options.how: No change to the merge tool.
options.label: Keep the hand-off to runner 10
options.lose: The slow path you objected to at 10:15 CST.

reply: Closed. Owner picked a in chat, 10:29 CST Nov 18 (relayed by the consultant): "this seems fine" - a Carried by line in the PR description, accepted like the session's own link; every other merge check stays. Owner's 10:27 CST words also hold: any standing session may merge a straggling PR. Home: the consultant's branch standing-merges-stragglers (not merged at 10:30 CST); the ruling goes in decision session-tiers with that change.

shown.label: A "Carried by" line in the pull request body that the carrying session adds (recommended by the consultant)
A builder first adds a reader of the goal text the harness stores, then the tool accepts pull requests that goal names

title: How should the consultant be allowed to merge the carry-list pull requests its goal names, with no hand-off to runner 10?
why: a needs no new reader and shows the carry in the pull request, but it is a weak limit; b is the strict route and costs build time. Recommended by the consultant, relayed, not owner-typed.
